joint_factor_name_cn: 截断支撑缺失解释规则
component_factors: near-field truncation factor + support failure feedback + vehicle-scale shell closure
runtime_observable_requirement: truncation and support field must be defined without GT
required_association: runtime state predicts support uncertainty before GT crop is inspected
physical_plausibility_requirement: partial visibility can physically shift or widen expected SAR support
independent_evidence_requirement: optical state and support geometry must be independent of GT
gt_positive_validation_requirement: if GT is used; GT-local morphology must show vehicle-scale structure near miss
non_target_negative_contrast_requirement: nearby support-internal tiny component or background must fail vehicle-scale closure
counterexample_requirement: complete visible counterexample must not trigger the rule
boundary_or_competition_requirement: competitor evidence keeps relation blocked when ambiguous
permission_requirement: GT can validate miss but cannot redefine support
forbidden_conclusion: final box; revised GT; GT-guided support expansion

joint_factor_name_cn: 可见未框住存在支持规则
component_factors: visible-unboxed existence support + SAR vehicle-scale shell + permission blocking
runtime_observable_requirement: visible optical evidence and detector gap must be observable without SAR GT
required_association: SAR evidence may support existence but not identity
physical_plausibility_requirement: incomplete optical box can coexist with vehicle-scale SAR morphology
independent_evidence_requirement: optical gap and SAR morphology must be separately sourced
gt_positive_validation_requirement: GT-local evidence may validate vehicle-like structure
non_target_negative_contrast_requirement: outside-GT background or competitor must not satisfy same shell
counterexample_requirement: visible gap caused by competitor blocks relation
boundary_or_competition_requirement: competitor risk must be explicitly checked
permission_requirement: permission gate limits conclusion to hypothesis

joint_factor_name_cn: 同色竞争边界保持规则
component_factors: same-color competitor risk + boundary preservation + weak optical thread conservativeness
runtime_observable_requirement: competition or preserved boundary must be visible in optical evidence
required_association: candidate relation must cross a known boundary or competitor context
physical_plausibility_requirement: similar vehicles make same-target bridging unsafe
independent_evidence_requirement: boundary evidence must be independent of SAR overlap
gt_positive_validation_requirement: GT may show target morphology but not resolve identity alone
non_target_negative_contrast_requirement: competitor or outside-GT region must be tested for similar cues
counterexample_requirement: single isolated target without competition is counterexample
boundary_or_competition_requirement: boundary remains active unless independent boundary evidence closes it

component_factors: SAR side-ridge persistence + non-jump SAR temporal drift + background static reflector rejection
runtime_observable_requirement: SAR evidence stage must be explicitly opened; no SAR GT in construction
required_association: ridge and drift must refer to the same local SAR structure
physical_plausibility_requirement: vehicle side return should persist or drift gradually
independent_evidence_requirement: ridge observation and temporal drift must be independently observed
gt_positive_validation_requirement: GT may validate that persistent ridge is vehicle-local
non_target_negative_contrast_requirement: static background ridge or guardrail must be rejected
counterexample_requirement: low-SNR missing frames or static reflector break rule
boundary_or_competition_requirement: competitor SAR structure must be checked
permission_requirement: GT crop cannot define ridge threshold
forbidden_conclusion: identity truth or selected SAR box

joint_factor_name_cn: 端点热点外壳闭合规则
component_factors: endpoint hotspot stability + weak opposite-side return + vehicle-scale shell closure
runtime_observable_requirement: SAR evidence stage must observe parts before GT validation
required_association: endpoint hotspot weak-side return and shell scale must be associated
physical_plausibility_requirement: parts must compose vehicle-scale structure rather than atom cluster
independent_evidence_requirement: hotspot and weak-side evidence cannot be the same measurement twice
gt_positive_validation_requirement: GT may validate part placement inside local vehicle region
non_target_negative_contrast_requirement: nearby isolated peaks and texture blobs must fail part-to-shell relation
counterexample_requirement: single hotspot without shell is counterexample
boundary_or_competition_requirement: neighbor vehicle part composition remains competition risk
permission_requirement: GT cannot create part labels used in runtime
forbidden_conclusion: bright point equals vehicle or final support

joint_factor_name_cn: 方位距离形态一致规则
component_factors: azimuth/range feasible domain + imaging geometry sector + vehicle-scale shell
runtime_observable_requirement: feasible domain must be constructed from runtime-safe geometry/calibration
required_association: domain and shell must intersect without GT-derived center
physical_plausibility_requirement: fan-polar geometry and vehicle size must be physically plausible
independent_evidence_requirement: geometry and SAR morphology evidence must be independent
gt_positive_validation_requirement: GT may validate that vehicle-local structure lies in domain
non_target_negative_contrast_requirement: nearby non-target structure in same domain must fail vehicle morphology
permission_requirement: GT center cannot define azimuth or range factor
notes: domain is not a selected box

required_association: SAR drift may support compatibility after SAR evidence stage opens
physical_plausibility_requirement: target should not teleport across optical or SAR time

gt_positive_validation_requirement: GT may validate local SAR persistence through gap
non_target_negative_contrast_requirement: nearby competitor drift or static background must not match

required_association: positive and negative regions must test same proposed mechanism
physical_plausibility_requirement: vehicle-like claim requires rejection of non-vehicle alternatives

required_association: posthoc validation evidence must not feed runtime construction
physical_plausibility_requirement: permission state is a physical graph gate for meaning
independent_evidence_requirement: provenance labels must independently identify GT/manual/selector/final sources
gt_positive_validation_requirement: GT may reveal leakage but cannot rescue the rule
non_target_negative_contrast_requirement: runtime layer must be reproducible without GT-local evidence

joint_factor_name_cn: 跨场景稳定 admission 规则
component_factors: cross-scene generalization + candidate factor definition + counterexample registry
runtime_observable_requirement: factor definition must be frozen before scene comparison
required_association: same factor must be comparable across scenes
physical_plausibility_requirement: physical explanation must survive scene changes
independent_evidence_requirement: evidence cannot be retuned per scene from GT
non_target_negative_contrast_requirement: scene-specific background and competitor negatives must be checked
counterexample_requirement: factor works only after local tuning or GT thresholding
boundary_or_competition_requirement: crowded and simple scenes must be separately reported
allowed_conclusion: candidate for future admitted graph factor

required_association: overlap can associate only as posthoc support
physical_plausibility_requirement: weak optical thread lacks identity strength
independent_evidence_requirement: SAR overlap and optical weakness are not independent proof of identity

non_target_negative_contrast_requirement: nearby competitors and background overlaps must be examined

joint_factor_name_cn: 机制支持非标注许可规则
component_factors: vehicle-scale shell + positive/negative GT validation + permission blocking
runtime_observable_requirement: candidate mechanism must be runtime-observable or explicitly posthoc-only
required_association: support is mechanism relation not label relation
physical_plausibility_requirement: vehicle-like morphology can explain but not authorize annotation
independent_evidence_requirement: GT validation and permission gate are independent
non_target_negative_contrast_requirement: non-target regions must fail the mechanism
counterexample_requirement: weak GT quality or support miss defers rule
permission_requirement: permission gate forbids annotation until later protocol
forbidden_conclusion: SAR-ready annotation; final boxes; revised GT
